blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Embassy in Paris has advised Filipinos in France to prepare 72-hour emergency kits and remain vigilant amid recurring protests across the country. In an advisory issued Monday evening (Manila time), the embassy said French authorities had urged the public to stock up on emergency supplies as part of the government’s ongoing […]...
